notes.title: Play the PS5 Version of CRUELTY at TGS2025 – CREEK & RIVER Booth
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the PS5 version of CRUELTY will be available for hands-on play at the CREEK & RIVER Co., Ltd. booth during Tokyo Game Show 2025!!


Thank you all for your continued support of CRUELTY.
This year, we have prepared a special demo space at the CREEK & RIVER booth, where you can experience the PS5 edition firsthand.
We look forward to welcoming you at the event!



About Tokyo Game Show
Tokyo Game Show (TGS), first held in 1996, is one of the largest and most prestigious gaming events in the world, celebrating its 29th anniversary in 2025.

Business Days: September 25 (Thu) 10:00–17:00 / September 26 (Fri) 10:00–17:00

notes.title: 【Version 1.2.0 Update】Updated to support 12 languages!
notes.content:
Dear User

I have updated CRUELTY to translate it into all 12 languages listed below.

English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), French, Italian, German, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil).

If there are errors in the translation, please report them in the thread.

notes.title: 【Version 1.1.1 Update】Fixed operability with gamepad.
notes.content:
Dear User
Thank you very much for your support.

I have made an update to improve gamepad operability in response to your feedback.
The fixes are as follows.

Fixed an issue where the camera would move left and right by adding play to the left stick button.
Fix to increase the sensitivity of the camera on the gamepad.

notes.title: 【ver1.1.0 Update】"Flashing Light Function" and "Invert Mouse Y-Axis Function"
notes.content:
Dear User
Thank you for your patience.
I have made the following corrections as requested.


Flashing light on/off function.
Invert Mouse Y-axis function of the mouse has been added.


The following changes can now be made from the settings screen.
The light flashing on/off function allows you to set whether or not specific lights appearing in the game, including the title screen, will flash.

* I apologize for the inconvenience, but the data structure of the save data will change,
and I ask that users who have started this product at least once before version 1.1.0 delete their save data.

In Windows, the save data is stored in the following locations
Delete all files in the SaveGames folder.
C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Cruelty\Saved\SaveGames.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.1 Update Notice" and "Warning about Photosensitive Seizures"
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing this product.
We have made an update to correct the following issues.

Bug in which buttons can be operated during movie scenes
Increased the brightness of the entire game.

In addition, a note has been added to the store page regarding "Warning about Photosensitivity Attacks.
This product contains flashing light expressions in some scenes, which may cause photosensitive epileptic seizures. If you have a history of seizures or epilepsy, please refrain from playing this product.
